data.text: I’ll commit to 18 tons this month, provided all five of us agree. Luke, I’d choose the 10-ton buffer: it sacrifices one ton each now but leaves us better placed if replenishment fails. For later months, I support Emma’s whole-ton allocation and rotating the extras, with no fishing at stocks of 10 or less. Let’s review the revealed catches each month without responding to any breach by overfishing ourselves. Kate, are you willing to join that agreement?
